hooks.command: if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Warning: jq not found; clang-format hook skipped' >&2; exit 0; fi; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qE '\.(cpp|h|hpp|cc|cxx)$'; then if command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1; then clang-format -i "$f"; else echo "Warning: clang-format not found; skipped formatting $f" >&2; fi; fi; } || true
